whatItIs: NaturesMud Dates Powder (Khajur / Chhokada Powder) is a 100% whole-fruit natural sweetener made by pitting, gently dehydrating, and cold-milling whole dry dates into a free-flowing caramel-brown powder. Unlike refined white table sugar—which is chemically bleached with sulphur and stripped of all minerals—our Dates Powder retains the whole date’s natural dietary fiber, iron, potassium, and caramel aroma with 0% anti-caking chemicals.
nepaliKitchenUses: Refined-Sugar Replacement for Baby Porridge: Stir 1 teaspoon (5g) into cooked rice lito, ragi porridge, suji kheer, or banana mash after cooking (for infants from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
Kids’ Warm Milk & Malted Drinks: Add 1 to 2 teaspoons to warm milk alongside Banana Powder, Strawberry Powder, or Beetroot Powder.
Everyday Halwa, Kheer & Baking: Replace white sugar 1:1 in gajar ko halwa, rice kheer, oat cookies, and whole-wheat cakes.
Morning Oatmeal & Dahi Sweetener: Sprinkle over plain dahi, muesli, or chia pudding for gentle whole-fruit sweetness.
whoItSuits: Essential for parents eliminating refined white sugar from baby and toddler meals (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician), health-conscious families, and home bakers.
monsoonStorage: Because Dates Powder is 100% pure fruit with 0% chemical anti-caking agents, humidity can cause soft clumping. Always use a dry spoon, never shake the jar directly over steaming pots, and tighten the lid immediately.

faqs.q: Can I use Dates Powder for my 6-month+ baby instead of white sugar?
faqs.a: Yes! Pediatric nutrition guidelines recommend avoiding refined white sugar for babies. NaturesMud Dates Powder is 100% whole fruit (0 additives), suitable for gently sweetening baby porridge from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician.

faqs.q: Does Dates Powder dissolve completely like white sugar in tea?
faqs.a: Because it is made from 100% whole ground dates (including natural fruit fiber) rather than refined crystals, it blends smoothly into milk, porridge, kheer, smoothies, and baking, and leaves a tiny trace of natural fruit fiber at the bottom of clear black tea.

faqs.q: How much Dates Powder equals 1 spoon of white sugar?
faqs.a: Use a 1:1 ratio by volume—1 teaspoon of Dates Powder replaces 1 teaspoon of white sugar with a rich, warm caramel note.

faqs.q: What if the Dates Powder forms soft lumps during monsoon?
faqs.a: Pure date sugar naturally absorbs air moisture because we add 0% chemical anti-caking agents. Simply press the soft lump with the back of a dry spoon or pulse briefly in a dry mixer.
